assertions.name: every_generator_touches_at_most_two_components
assertions.source: THE CONNECTED-SUM PREMISE, measured rather than assumed. A summand reaching three components would break the argument at its first step.

assertions.name: generators_joining_two_members_of_a_min_span_triple
assertions.source: THE RESULT. Summed over all min-span triples of all 8 isotopes (A = 4..16). Not one, so every such triple is separated and its sublink is SPLIT (not an unlink -- the components are (2,odd)-torus knots; splitness is what the vanishing needs).

assertions.name: component_count_law_mu_equals_A_plus_1
assertions.source: cross-check against the recorded law, computed here from the permutation independently of the sibling probe. If this failed the path structure the argument rests on would have changed.

assertions.name: min_span_family_size_equals_A_minus_3
assertions.source: the count that made this family the only saturation-compatible candidate. Verified here so the family being excluded is the same one qou-768r named.

description: EXPLORATORY. Route 3 of qou-768r wanted a first Milnor mubar value on the min-span triples {i, i+2, i+4} -- the only named subfamily whose count (A-3, per-component multiplicity <= 3) survives CoordinationSaturation. This shows the computation is unnecessary: mubar VANISHES there, and the reason is its own defining condition. A monotone braid closure is a connected sum of (2,k) torus links, so each summand comes from one generator and touches at most 2 components (MEASURED, max 2 across 8 isotopes). A shared summand links two components, so a Delta = 0 triple -- the condition for mubar to be a genuine integer -- shares NO summand, its sublink is a 3-component UNLINK, and every Milnor invariant vanishes on it. Measured: 0 generators join two members of any min-span triple, across A = 4..16. BRANCH-INDEPENDENT: which components a generator touches is fixed by the permutation, and a superposition letter projects to the same transposition as its sigma branch. Scope (b) on the min-span family; does NOT refute route 3 in general (on a Brunnian carrier like L6a4 the summand hypothesis fails and mubar_123 = 1) and does NOT touch the Delta = 2 one-bit triples. Nothing wired.

the_mechanism.monotone_closure: one contiguous run per generator => the closure is a connected sum of (2,k) torus links #_g T(2, e_g), verified 32/32 in SnapPy (docs/audits/2026-08-25-atom-word-closures-are-not-hyperbolic.md)
the_mechanism.summand_reach: each summand is one generator's run, so it touches only the components containing strands g and g+1
the_mechanism.the_step: a shared summand LINKS two components; contrapositively a Delta = 0 triple shares no summand, so its sublink is a 3-component UNLINK and every Milnor invariant vanishes
the_mechanism.the_punchline: the condition that makes mubar DEFINED (Delta = 0) is the condition that makes it ZERO

why_branch_independent.claim: this measurement does not depend on how the 2^(2A+1) superposition letters resolve to crossing signs
why_branch_independent.reason: which components a generator touches is fixed by the induced PERMUTATION, and a superposition letter c*sigma_g + d*1 projects to the same transposition (g, g+1) as its sigma branch
why_branch_independent.contrast: lk IS branch-dependent, which is why the sibling probe fh_genus_handle_requires_brunnian checks both branches. This one is a single measurement, not a sampling.

what_this_does_NOT_establish.route_3_in_general: NOT refuted. On a genuinely Brunnian carrier the summand hypothesis fails -- L6a4 has mubar_123 = 1
what_this_does_NOT_establish.delta_2_triples: NOT examined. Triples touching a linked pair have Delta = 2 and retain ONE BIT; they are the residual
what_this_does_NOT_establish.the_carrier_itself: untouched -- this is about which invariants of it can be nonzero, not about whether it is the right carrier
what_this_does_NOT_establish.scope: (b) on the min-span family, invariant cited

q0AnchorReason: reads no q0. Inputs are the permutation cycles of the canonical atom braid word and integer generator/component incidence counts. No substrate pin is evaluated on any path, so no q0Value exists.
